source_of_truth: Read by hand. AppInput.vue has a single root <UInput v-model="model" v-bind="$attrs" /> and its script holds defineOptions plus `const model = defineModel<string>()`; the contract's pass-through-wrapper requires no props, no emits, NO MODELS and no behaviour beyond defineOptions/$attrs, so the model alone makes it a library-wrapper that is not a pass-through. AppBadge.vue has a single root <UBadge v-bind="$attrs"><slot /></UBadge>, no props/emits/models and only defineOptions in the script: a genuine pass-through. Both start with a doc comment and both are exported from index.ts.

expected.rationale: single library root, forwards $attrs and the default slot, declares nothing of its own

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: it declares a model (defineModel<string>()), which the contract lists among the things a pass-through must not have; a v-model surface is an API of its own
